items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: On 18 August, SpaceX logged its 100th launch of 2026, hitting that mark two months faster than it did in 2024 — a company that flew 25 times in 2020 is now lifting off more than three times a week
items.summary:
The routinization of spaceflight is reshaping what's possible in orbit—and challenging our intuitions about technological breakthroughs.

items.label: Tesla
items.headline: Tesla Shares Climb Nearly 3% to $336 as Robotaxi Gains and AI Push Offset Profit Pressure
items.summary: Tesla shares rose nearly 3% after reporting record vehicle deliveries and advancements in AI and autonomy, despite facing profitability challenges and increased capital expenditures.
